intent: give every font file of a family a short file name that fits a delivery standard, stays readable and stays unique

in.name: folder
in.text: the folder of exported font files (.otf, .ttf, .woff, .woff2), named Family-Style

out.text: the table of old and new names, and the path of the undo log

rules.label: Destination folder or URL; its length counts against the path limit
Shortening method (auto: the method of the standard)
Shorten every style of the family to the same level
Ask the model for abbreviations when the table is not enough
rules.note: off: take the names of code, also cut ones; the person still agrees. For dos83 no table is fair

rules.label: Shortest and longest abbreviation that the model may propose, in letters
rules.note: 5088 abbreviations have two or three letters; four leaves room for family words. One letter is an initial, not an abbreviation

rules.label: Most test calls in the abbreviation arena
Folder of the undo logs, relative to the tool folder
The tool may rename files
rules.note: off: a dry run. The run ends at ready and renames nothing.

flow.name: Read the folder
flow.do: list the font files; split each name into family words and style words

flow.name: Font files to name
flow.check: the folder has at least one font file, and every name has a family before the hyphen

flow.name: Shorten with the table
flow.do: build the short names with the built-in table; when shorten.ask_model is on, list the words that the table does not know in the names that needed dropped vowels, initials or a cut

flow.name: Propose abbreviations
flow.intent: propose short abbreviations for the family and style words that the table does not know
flow.do: propose a table of abbreviations, one for each weak word, as type designers write them (Grotesque: Grt): the first letter of the word, then letters of the word in their order, {shorten.abbr_letters} letters (shortest, longest). Test each table with try_names before you answer; table shows the built-in words

flow.name: Abbreviations are fair
flow.check: each abbreviation is a word of the family, starts with its first letter, keeps the order of its letters, has {shorten.abbr_letters} letters (shortest, longest), and no name needs dropped vowels, initials or a cut

flow.name: Final names
flow.do: build the names again with the built-in table and the best fair table of the model

flow.name: Every name fits the standard
flow.check: every new name fits {target.standard}: its length, its characters and the reserved names

flow.name: No two files share a name
flow.check: no two new names are equal when case is ignored, and no new name is the name of another file

fail.when: two files would get the same name

flow.name: The names read well
flow.check: read the new names as a type designer would: pass when the family and the style can still be recognised in each name

fail.when: the names do not read well

flow.name: A file gets a new name
flow.check: at least one file gets a new name

fail.when: every file has its short name already

flow.name: Rename these files?
flow.check: show the person the table of old and new names

flow.name: Rename
flow.do: write the undo log, then rename each file in two phases

flow.name: Every file renamed
flow.check: every new name is there, no old or temporary name is left, and the count of font files did not change

flow.name: Dry run: the table is ready, nothing renamed
The person said no: nothing renamed
Put the names back
flow.do: rename every file of this run back, from its undo log

intent_spec.text: give every font file of a family a short file name that fits a delivery standard, stays readable and stays unique
intent_spec.style: names a type designer can read: table abbreviations, no dropped vowels, no cut words

never.text: rename a file without the approval of a person
rename a file when permissions.rename is off
give two files the same name
